description: Owner picks added to the curated port shelf on top of the source list; scripts/curated-ports.js merges these in. Add "replaces": "owner/repo" to swap out a listed entry (e.g. a build repo for a source-only decomp).

apps.name: Quake (ironwail)
apps.note: Quake engine. Needs the Quake data (id1/pak0.pak, pak1.pak) from the user.

apps.name: QuakeInjector
apps.note: Browses and installs Quake maps and mods from Quaddicted; point it at an engine.

apps.name: Doom Launcher
apps.note: Doom front end with an /idgames browser; point it at an engine and your IWADs.

apps.name: Doom Retro
apps.note: Doom engine. Needs an IWAD (doom.wad, doom2.wad) from the user.

apps.name: DSDA-Doom
apps.note: Doom engine (speedrunning/demo-accurate). Needs an IWAD from the user.

apps.name: r2modman (Thunderstore mod manager)
apps.note: Thunderstore's mod manager. The filter picks the portable exe, not r2modman-Setup; update it if r2modman reaches version 4.
